act1-rule.title: The door, before anyone has knocked
act1-rule.shows: The rule the room publishes, and an empty log. Four numbers: a network, a context, two block heights and the threshold.

act2-admitted.title: ADMITTED, and the five markers
act2-admitted.shows: A real holder is admitted, and the gate writes down the only thing it keeps: five markers that name these coins at this room and nowhere else.

act3-refused.title: The same coins again
act3-refused.shows: ALREADY_USED_IN_CONTEXT. The markers are unchanged, because the refusal wrote nothing at all.

act4-newcomer.title: A newcomer, 20,332 blocks too new
act4-newcomer.shows: A real proof against a root this gate never pinned: ROOT_MISMATCH. The rail is broken rather than stretched, with the real distance printed on the mark.

act5-second-room.title: The same coins at a second room
act5-second-room.shows: Admitted again, with a marker set that shares nothing with the first room's. Neither gate's log matches the other's.
